content.short: A p2p directory of places, businesses and professionals in the Cardano universe.
content.description:
ADAPlaces is a simple p2p directory of places, businesses and professionals with public information to achieve a wider adoption to trade in the physical and digital world with assets within the Cardano ecosystem. Our intention is to connect all these people so that they can then trade with each other, have reviews from other users and grow organically into a community based on how well you perform with other people.

In the future and if we manage to finance ourselves properly we want this simple directory to expand to a p2p marketplace to trade products or services in a simple way, participating only as arbiters of the operations and operating through smart contracts.
